comparison_stage: eight rounds retained: four baseline, two initial_eager_stats, two final_on_demand_stats
modified_source: Original novovm-node on current main plus bounded per-recipient gossip reservations. Initial eager diagnostic refresh and final on-demand diagnostic snapshot are separate measured variants with separate binary hashes.
product_path: crates/novovm-node native_resident profile, existing original-node RPC and resident AOEM owner
result: All eight rounds passed. Final variant pooled throughput is 9064.631698 TPS: +6.052021 percent against its interleaved old3/old4 rounds and +0.958546 percent against ALL four baseline rounds. About 9K healthy-load throughput is retained; these samples do not establish a stable speedup. The initial_eager_stats -6.956768 percent regression is preserved separately. final1 had one observation HTTP connection timeout, retained with its event; all transactions later completed four-node observation and cold economic verification.

binary.test_hash_note: Initial new1/new2 used measurement_test_sha256; final1/final2 used final_variant_measurement_test_sha256. Both node and test hashes were checked against the actual binaries. Initial artifacts are not relabelled as final measurements.

environment.topology: One host; four actual original novovm-node processes with independent AOEM databases, existing WSS relay and E2E/NovoRUDP transport configuration.
environment.measured_node_copies: frozen baseline binary versus modified original-node binary

method.tps_numerator: Unique successful transactions observed finalized on ALL four nodes; not multiplied by replica count, signature checks, or gossip counters.
method.timed_interval: First HTTP submission to all unique four-node finalized receipts; signing, startup and cold database oracle excluded.
method.pooled_tps: sum(finalized_successful) / sum(elapsed_seconds), not arithmetic mean of per-run TPS.
method.latency_us: For each transaction: max(finalized_us over all four nodes) - first_submit_us. Sort all samples, select index ceil(N*p/100)-1. Includes HTTP and bounded observation scheduling, not pure execution latency.
method.merged_percentiles: Concatenate complete 65536-row observation arrays in the named group, calculate latency per row, then use nearest rank on 131072 samples for two-run groups or 262144 for all four baselines. Never average run percentiles.
method.observation_archive: Each observations.zip contains the full original observations.json, losslessly compressed. Decompressed SHA256 was checked against its original; no sampling.
method.event_logs: Seven events.jsonl files were empty. final1 had one 6323-byte observation connection-timeout event, copied unmodified as final1-events.jsonl. All complete transaction observations and original process-test logs are retained.
method.omitted_copies: No database, validator key, node configuration, or unrelated historical evidence was copied. Originals remain at the recorded source paths.

pooled.stage: intermediate_only; do not present as the final variant
pooled.interpretation: Observed regression in the initial eager diagnostic variant, not a speedup or a final-variant result. Unnecessary per-poll peer-map refresh work was removed in the separately measured final_on_demand_stats variant below. These initial rounds remain intact. Two samples cannot establish a stable capacity ceiling or attribute all variance. Recipient-isolation fault correctness is a separate acceptance dimension.

final_comparison.interpretation: The final variant keeps roughly 9K TPS in this environment. The +6.05 percent recent comparison must be accompanied by +0.96 percent against all four baselines; this is not a stable speedup or capacity ceiling claim. Final pooled P95 is slightly worse than all-baseline P95 while P99 is lower. No discarded slow rounds.

four_independent_database_audits.cold_receipt_and_full_economic_oracle: passed by the unchanged load fixture and recorded per-database audits

each_node_async_authentication.scope: Authentication work counters, not a TPS numerator.

gossip.note: All peers were healthy in these performance runs. Zero recipient skips does not exercise offline isolation. Taken credit is flow control only, not pool admission or finality.

live_last_errors: decision not for exact current parent
successor body lacks exact locally executed durable parent
retained_noise.last_error_note: Most snapshots contain the old-parent decision rejection; final1 node3 contains collector vote context mismatch, final2 node1 contains successor body lacks exact locally executed durable parent. Retained verbatim in the original reports, not counted as unsuccessful transactions.
retained_noise.process_logs: Connection-reset teardown messages remain in the unmodified logs; passing does not mean there were no error messages.

observation_error.transport_error: http://127.0.0.1:64184/: Connection Failed: Connect error: connection timed out: connection timed out
observation_error.classification: Observation HTTP connection timeout, not a failed admission or business execution. Subsequent bounded observations completed all four-node receipts; the original failure event remains in evidence.

fault_acceptance.status: final binary passed isolated offline-peer progress/catchup/restart and actual honest A/A/B recovery; separate from healthy throughput
fault_acceptance.offline_topology: Three original nodes online, fourth absent then joins; same four-validator set and three-signature quorum
fault_acceptance.aab_topology: Three original nodes plus one test-only Byzantine peer signing only its own proposals
fault_acceptance.scope: Functional recovery, not low fault latency, in-flight write failure, four-machine or mainnet acceptance

limitations: Windows single-host evidence with four original-node executables, not four physical machines or public-network acceptance.
Only success-oriented 65536-transfer load: zero business failures is not mixed-failure throughput evidence.
BFT durable finality and AOEM readback are not zero-knowledge business validity proofs.
This measures the resident CPU-stage product path, not GPU or unified algebraic execution completion.
Early-body reuse counters are not equivalent to early authentication completion; each raw report retains the completed-before-parent counters.
Pending admission and best-effort gossip are not durable wallet acceptance or guaranteed delivery to every peer.
No production deployment, mainnet safety, sustained soak, or Linux runtime readiness is signed off by this comparison.
